annotations.title: World gold price in any currency

description: Today's world (spot) gold price for one gram, one troy ounce and one kilogram of fine gold, in the currency asked for (a three-letter code such as USD, EUR, SGD, AUD, GBP, MYR or IDR), with the time it was read. Built from the gold price in US dollars (gold-api.com) and that day's exchange rate (open.er-api.com). A world-market indication, not what any dealer pays or charges.

currency.description: Three-letter currency code (ISO 4217), e.g. USD, EUR, SGD, AUD, GBP, IDR. Default USD.

lang.description: Answer language: id = Bahasa Indonesia, en = English (default).
